name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - Après le considérant AD - Am 5
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: ADa. whereas in 2026, 11 out of 20 assessed stocks remain overfished with, notably, European hake and Norway lobster remaining in poor condition; whereas fleet overcapacity is still significant for the fleets covered by WestMed MAP; whereas implementation, compliance, monitoring and control by the respective Member States are inconsistent1a; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Kramer, E., ‘Implementation of the WestMed MAP Regulation – A review of existing evaluations’, European Parliament Research Service, July 2026.
